column4: BaselineChannelRenamer rewrites ONLY the "channel" field of each baseline entry (src/Infrastructure/Console/Command/BaselineRenameChannelsCommand.php:17-30, doc: "Rewrite the channel names ... nothing else: subject keys, occurrence, count, magnitudes, mode and edge are carried through untouched"). No other baseline field carries a metric key: an entry has {channel, occurrence, count[, magnitude/mode/edge]} only (src/Analysis/Policy/Baseline/BaselineGenerator.php:131, BaselineUpdater.php:271 — magnitude is a bare number). An un-migrated old channel makes the entry inert: FindingFilterOrchestrator.php:179 prints "N baseline entries could not be applied and are not suppressing anything", InertEntryReason.php:60 names the reason UndeclaredChannel, and the finding that would have been suppressed is reported at its own severity instead.
